title: Customized 3D-printed surgical templates for maxillary repositioning: a systematic review
html: There is a variety of three-dimensional (3D) surgical templates to improve the precision of maxillary repositioning in orthognathic surgery. The spectrum and inconsistent terminology make it difficult to compare outcomes, practices, and selecting the most suitable templates. The aim of this systematic review was to analyse the literature on 3D-printed surgical templates used in orthognathic surgery, with the goal of mapping existing approaches and proposing a classification system based on design and reported outcomes.
